item.title: 【HD Live Performances】FEED - BABYMONSTER [CHOOM] WORLD TOUR 2026-27 IN JAPAN [WOWOW] (1080i HD)
item.description:
BABYMONSTER [CHOOM] WORLD TOUR 2026-27 IN JAPAN [WOWOW] (1080i HD)​


​
BABYMONSTER, who kicked off their world tour in support of their 3rd mini-album "CHOOM" released in May, will have their performance at Kyocera Dome Osaka on September 23rd, the finale of their Japanese leg of the tour, broadcast live. One year after their first world tour held last year, this second world tour is a more globally-oriented project, with the lineup now including not only South Korea, Japan and other Asian countries, as well as North America, but also Oceania, Europe, and South America, traveling across five continents. The Japanese leg of the tour, which started in Seoul, will visit Kobe, Fukuoka, Yokohama, Chiba, and Nagoya, and will culminate in their first-ever dome performance at Kyocera Dome Osaka, continuing their worldwide journey until 2027.



More information: https://wod.wowow.co.jp/program/207470
